text:
Maria Chen: Hey design — we need a small asset set for the upcoming perf webinar and benchmark post. Deliverables: webinar hero (3 sizes), benchmark infographic (print + web), 2 social card sizes, editable slide deck master, and a small one-pager for SDRs with routing snippet. Deadline: EOD next Wed. Can you confirm capacity?

Jake Patel: @Maria thanks — can you confirm the benchmark data source? CSV or a figma chart? Also do we need localized versions (EN/FR/DE)? :thinking: 

Maria Chen: CSV attached in the Drive (I'll drop link in a sec). Yes please: EN + FR for launch. DE is nice-to-have. Use the canonical brand color tokens. Need the infographic to include three charts: latency vs cost bar, throughput heatmap, and callout for 99th pct.

Ella Rodriguez: I can prep copy variations. For the SDR one-pager we need: 1) 1-sentence elevator, 2) 3 bullets on differentiators, 3) routing snippet (HubSpot). I'll paste sample routing next message.

Samir Khan: For social we need both square (1080x1080) and landscape (1200x628). Also provide a version with speaker headshots masked for Twitter card. :+1:

Jake Patel: Copy and sizes noted. Quick Q on fonts — are we allowed to use Inter var or should we stick to the locked web font set? Also do we need accessible color contrast for the heatmap palette?

Maria Chen: Stick to the locked set (Inter + Redwood Display). Yes keep AA contrast for body text and make sure the heatmap has a clear legend and an accessible alt text string in the one-pager.

Ella Rodriguez: Routing snippet for SDRs (copy to paste into HubSpot workflow):

```
If "Attended webinar" AND "Downloaded benchmark one-pager" -> Route to SDR queue: "Inbound-Webinar-Perf" (priority: medium)
Assign owner: round-robin across SDR team
Add note: "source:webinar-2026-03-25"
```

Jake Patel: Great — any brand lockups/partner logos we must include? I have a slide template that needs the primary lockup + small sponsor row.

Maria Chen: Only Redwood lockup + conference partner (CloudConf) — sponsor logos must be monochrome white on dark banners. I uploaded the approved logos to the Brand folder: https://drive.redwood/brand/approved/logos (figma-bot will also have the file).

figma-bot: Figma file created: "Webinar — Perf & Benchmark Assets" — https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/webinar-assets — check pages: "export-ready" and "templates".

Jake Patel: I'll start comps today. Plan: 1) hero + X variants in frame, 2) infographic master in A3 and web PNG export presets, 3) slide deck master with speaker and sponsor frames, 4) one-pager PDF + editable figma. ETA for first draft: Mon EOD. @Ella, can you drop the final copy by Mon noon?

Ella Rodriguez: Yep — will deliver copy variants and alt text CSV by Mon 11:30.

Maria Chen: Heads-up for localization: keep copy length tight — FR translations tend to be ~15% longer. Leave flexible copy areas in the Figma components.

Samir Khan: Also suggest we include two CTA treatments in the hero: "Register now" and "View benchmark" — we can A/B later.

Jake Patel: Noted. Also export settings I'll use (so ops can automate):

```
PNG web: 1x and 2x, sRGB, export suffix: @1x / @2x
PDF print: CMYK, 300dpi, bleed 3mm
Slide deck: PPTX export from Figma + native .fig file for edits
```

Maria Chen: Perfect. Last thing — please tag deliverables with catalog labels for marketing assets: "webinar-perf-2026", "benchmark-1pager-2026". We'll need those for tracking spend and downstream analytics. :memo:

Jake Patel: Will do. If no blockers I’ll share the Figma draft by Mon.

Ella Rodriguez: :eyes: looking forward to it.

Maria Chen: Thanks team — appreciate quick turn here.
